Korean Spicule Care
Two ways to film it.

Two video ideas. Pick one.

1

Korean spicule care

What's spicule care?

A watery serum with tiny spicules in it.

You pat it on at night, first. The tingle is the spicules doing their job.

What you get
  • Smoother texturefewer bumps and rough patches
  • Tighter-looking poresless congestion, a cleaner look
  • Glass skin glowskin that reflects light
  • Makeup that sits betterno lifting, no patches
Why spicule care?

Your actives aren't the problem. Getting them in is.

You already use the good stuff: acids, retinol, vitamin C. But skin is built to keep things out, so most of it sits on top. Spicules open the way first. Then everything you put on after actually gets in, and that's when texture and pores start to change.

Good actives→They sit on top→Spicules open the way→Actives get in→Texture, pores, glass skin

Must-haves

Must

  • Old clips first, same angle as your skin now
  • Say spicule was the key
  • Say how long you've used it
  • Glass skin close-up, bare skin, no filter
  • The Reedle Shot in your hand in the last scene
  • Say the Korean original spicule serum did it

Don't

  • Brand or product name out loud. Say spicule serum
  • Never say needles or microneedling
  • Cured, healed
  • Other brand names
  • Unboxing
